_comment: Fresh NL questions for the agent-as-compiler POC. Disjoint from the 20-query dev benchmark and from RulesGuru (held out). Witness = card that must appear in results; absent = card that must not.

questions.q: creatures whose enter-the-battlefield trigger deals damage to each opponent
cards that double the number of +1/+1 counters you put on creatures
lands with an activated ability that sacrifices the land itself to draw a card
creatures that get a +1/+1 counter whenever you gain life
spells that counter a spell unless its controller pays mana
cards with a trigger that makes an opponent lose life whenever they discard a card
cards that mill a player whenever that player draws a card
planeswalkers with an ability that returns a creature card from a graveyard to the battlefield
